retained_foundations: Bhatt–Scholze and Wu supply the integral crystalline and étale comparisons at this finite cyclotomic extension. The finite-dimensional de Rham functor is strict on crystalline exact sequences.

WCC7 uses the invariant-ring parameter and v+p from W80N1 at level one, with the representation crystalline already over the unramified field. Residual Sen multiplicities and the carry argument are proved in the earlier level-one and character-obstruction texts.
The scope is the specified period rings and crystalline representations. Independent axioms for arbitrary abstract period data in historical modules retain their stated hypotheses.

WCC8 uses Fontaine’s exact integral cyclotomic equivalence and the tame action at the origin of the unramified level-one Wach lattice. WCC9 uses exactness of the residue realization. Detecting split extensions additionally uses its fixed-vector property. In the canonical level-one realization WCC8 derives that property from full faithfulness and the full cyclotomic action.

formal_consumer.scope: This consumer takes the source and target height inclusions to its cokernel calculation. Kernel crystallinity, exactness of jumps and a preliminary power annihilator also enter there.
